summary: Tomany Mountain lookout, Hamilton County NY: 1912 wooden tower, 1916 steel tower, closed 1970, dismantled 1986 or 1987; footers and trail remain.

facts.design: Wooden observation tower (1912), replaced in 1916 by a 50-ft Aermotor LL-25 steel tower
facts.status_note: Tower dismantled; pieces left near the summit (Wikipedia, Daily Gazette). The summit still has footers and cabin remnants (Speculator Chamber).

access.note: Unmaintained hiking trail of about 1.9 miles from NY Route 10 (Wikipedia). The route is not officially maintained (Speculator Chamber). No source read states the legal access status.

visit.trail_note: Unmaintained trail from NY Route 10, with old state trail markers and telephone poles along the route. The tower itself is gone.

events.note: Wikipedia describes a wooden fire observation tower built by the Conservation Commission in 1912. A Daily Gazette column describes the first lookout as a spiral staircase up a white pine tree.
Replaced with a 50-foot Aermotor LL25 tower.
New observer's cabin built beside the older model 1922 cabin.
Closed at the end of the 1970 fire season. Wikipedia links the closure to fire detection by aircraft.
Station declared surplus property, per the Starr list, after a stand-by period.
Dismantling in August 1986 per the Starr list. The Daily Gazette gives 1987.

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the core history: Wikipedia, the Starr list and the Starr pictorial. Two conflicts are reported in the story. (1) First structure: Wikipedia says a wooden tower built 1912; the Daily Gazette says a spiral staircase up a white pine tree. (2) Dismantling: the Starr list says August 1986; the Daily Gazette says 1987. Elevation differs too (Wikipedia 2,589 ft, Starr list 2,579 ft, Speculator Chamber 2,550 ft); no elevation is used. An FFLA NY Facebook post about a visit to the site was seen only as a title, so it is not used. The site description rests on Speculator Chamber and the Daily Gazette column, both hiking write-ups; neither is an official land-manager source, and no official access rule was found. No photo was added.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia describes a wooden fire observation tower built in 1912. The Daily Gazette says the first lookout was a spiral staircase up a white pine tree. The story reports both.
The Starr list gives August 1986 for the dismantling. The Daily Gazette gives 1987. The story reports 1986 from the Starr list and notes the other date.
Wikipedia gives 2,589 ft, the Starr list 2,579 ft, and Speculator Chamber 2,550 ft. No elevation is used in the story.
